sujet: Organiser une activité prend des heures (3)

scenes.prompt: A tired but smiling French father at a kitchen table late in the evening, surrounded by piles of paper, scissors, glue, tape, crumpled drafts and a half-made cardboard treasure chest, a wall clock, a cat asleep on the papers, a child in pajamas peeking from the doorway.

A busy French mother on the living room floor cutting paper clues and taping envelopes, craft supplies everywhere, a laptop open, three impatient children aged 7 to 10 waiting on the sofa with arms crossed, a dog carrying a roll of tape.

A relaxed smiling French mother sits on a sofa holding a smartphone with a blank screen, while three children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume jump with excitement around her.

Four children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet read a rolled parchment clue together, one pointing with a magnifying glass at an old stone door, in a cobbled Alsatian lane with half-timbered houses and red geraniums.

Two relaxed parents sit on a wooden bench with coffee cups, smiling, in a flowery Alsatian village square with half-timbered houses, watching a group of children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns solving a riddle near a stone fountain, laughing together.

scenes.prompt: A group of children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights proudly lift a small open treasure chest glowing with gold, a kind old wise man with a long white beard and a burgundy cloak applauds, smiling parents behind, in a sunny Alsatian street with half-timbered houses and flower boxes.
